children: Overview
US venture debt provider's Q3 net investment income fell year-over-year
Net asset value per share declined to $8.32 from $8.73 at prior year-end
Company declared Q4 regular distribution of $0.23 per share
Outlook
Company declared Q4 2026 regular distribution of $0.23 per share
Company to pay $0.06 per share supplemental distribution on December 30, 2026
Company's adviser to waive quarterly income incentive fee through end of fiscal 2027
Result Drivers
LOWER YIELDS - Co said lower investment yields, partly due to a lower Prime rate, reduced investment income in the qtr
HIGHER INTEREST EXPENSES - Co reported increased interest expense and higher operating costs in the qtr
REALIZED LOSSES - Co said realized losses were mainly due to the sale and write-off of investments in certain portfolio companies
